title: BEST PLAYER IN EUROPE, MISSING THE BIGGEST GAME: THE NEDVĚD STORY
description:
Furia Ceca to Italy. Méďa, the little bear, to Czechia. One mane, two names.

Italian fans called Pavel Nedvěd Furia Ceca. Czech fans called him Méďa. A little bear with a lion's mane? Respect.

Then the heartbreak. The 1996 Euro final was lost to Germany on a golden goal. In 2003 he won the Ballon d'Or, and the same year a suspension kept him out of the Champions League final. He came out of international retirement for the 2006 World Cup, and Czechia finished third in their group.

Golden goal, golden career, bronze group stage. Pick your metal.

Which hurts more: the 1996 golden goal or missing the 2003 final? Vote in the comments.
